entities.name: UE radio capability signalling optimisation
entities.description: Optional feature that optimizes transmission of UE radio capability over the radio interface by using UE radio capability IDs as alternatives to full capability containers.

entities.name: UE radio capability ID
entities.description: Identifier representing a set of UE radio capabilities, which can be manufacturer-assigned or network-assigned.

entities.name: RACS bit
entities.description: Bit in UE network capability IE indicating UE support for RACS, set to 'RACS supported' in ATTACH REQUEST and TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST messages.

entities.name: UE radio capability ID availability IE
entities.description: Information element included in ATTACH REQUEST and TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST messages to indicate availability of UE radio capability ID.

entities.name: UE radio capability information update needed IE
entities.description: Information element included in TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message when UE radio configuration changes.

entities.name: UE radio capability ID deletion indication IE
entities.description: Information element set to 'Network-assigned UE radio capability IDs deletion requested' to trigger deletion of stored network-assigned IDs.

entities.name: ATTACH REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message used in attach procedure that may contain RACS-related information elements.

entities.name: TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message used in tracking area updating procedure that may contain RACS-related information elements.

entities.name: SECURITY MODE COMPLETE
entities.description: NAS message that may contain UE radio capability ID IE when requested by network during security mode control procedure.

entities.name: Security mode control procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by network to retrieve UE radio capability ID from UE.

entities.name: Tracking area updating procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE when radio configuration changes or when triggered by network for UE radio capability ID management.

entities.name: UE radio configuration change
entities.description: Condition where UE radio configuration changes (e.g., disabling specific radio capability) triggering tracking area updating procedure.

entities.name: Store network-assigned UE radio capability ID
entities.description: UE stores network-assigned UE radio capability ID, PLMN ID, and mapping to current UE radio configuration in non-volatile memory.

entities.name: Delete network-assigned UE radio capability IDs
entities.description: UE deletes all network-assigned UE radio capability IDs stored for serving network when triggered by network.

relations.description: ATTACH REQUEST message contains RACS bit in UE network capability IE to indicate RACS support.
ATTACH REQUEST message contains UE radio capability ID availability IE when UE has applicable UE radio capability ID.
TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message contains UE radio capability ID availability IE when UE has applicable UE radio capability ID.
TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message contains UE radio capability information update needed IE when UE radio configuration changes.
SECURITY MODE COMPLETE message contains UE radio capability ID IE when requested by network.
UE radio configuration change condition triggers initiation of tracking area updating procedure.
Security mode control procedure includes sending SECURITY MODE COMPLETE message with UE radio capability ID.
UE radio capability ID deletion indication IE set to deletion requested establishes deletion of stored network-assigned IDs.
Presence of UE radio capability ID availability IE in messages guards initiation of security mode control procedure by network.
Deletion of network-assigned UE radio capability IDs establishes initiation of tracking area updating procedure.
